description:
`:erlang.abs(-3)` compiles as field access and fails at runtime (fz_struct_get_named_field_ref: ExpectedTag). Cause: decode makes (".",2) an Expr::Index; direct_callee (jobs/body.rs) and CallableName::from_expr (src/ast/mod.rs:62) accept only Var/Module/Index chains, so an Expr::Atom base falls through to FieldAccess.

Scope split (2026-11-10, user-approved): the CALL half, where an atom-valued receiver (literal or variable) makes a remote call, moved to session fz-da's lane as part of fz-3ul.4 (defexception), as "calls on a module value". The literal atom base is that ticket's known-atom case. Its atom -> ModuleId resolution goes through the one module-name authority that fz-sc8.25 establishes, not a second lookup. That ticket blocks this one once filed.

This ticket keeps: atom module names, as in Elixir where a module's identity is an atom. Module paths may be a single atom, and `defmodule :erlang` parses (parse_module/parse_upper_path in frontdoor.rs accept Tok::Atom). lib/erlang.fz defines :erlang with float_to_binary/2 and decimals: N (fixed notation, correctly rounded, as Rust format!("{:.*}", n, x)), with a runtime extern via alloc_text (runtime/src/ir_runtime.rs).

comments.text: Unblocked by fz-3sy.4 once stack #428 (PRs #407, #427, #434) lands: x.f(a) on a module value is a DirectCall with DirectCallee::ModuleValue, resolved in semantic's resolve_module_value_call through ModuleName::from_atom_name -> World::reference_module -> World::module_public_function. What remains here: ModuleName::from_atom_name maps only Elixir.-prefixed atoms, so :erlang.abs(-3) is refused with type/module-value-call (emit_atom_names_no_module, jobs/semantic.rs); teach that function and defmodule :erlang about bare-atom module names. A receiver typed plain atom stays refused until fz-3sy.5. (Reported by the fz-da session; not re-verified here.)

Confirmed 2026-11-13 as the distiller's next divergence once fz-sc8.146 is past (scratch: Stream flattening + raised budget): Distill.fmt_ms/1 fails with 'StructField: subject is not a map or Struct' on interp and exit 134 on run/build. One-line repro /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/nx/B.exs: IO.puts(:erlang.float_to_binary(1.5 / 1_000_000, decimals: 1)) (elixir prints 0.0); fails the same on unmodified f04c56f8e. The call lowers as const :erlang -> field .float_to_binary -> closure_call because direct_callee (jobs/body.rs ~5240) returns None on an Atom base. Also /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/nx/B2.exs: :nosuch.thing(1) crashes the same way where Elixir raises UndefinedFunctionError; this ticket's fix must make that loud too.

develop ff4a75ada (fz-sc8.127/.155/.156 and fz-da's fz-3sy stack + fz-3ul.4 merged): the distiller stops on all three paths at compile time with error[type/module-value-call]: call to float_to_binary/2 on the atom :erlang, which names no module (tools/distill-telemetry.exs:345). The call half is done; this ticket's kept half (bare-atom module names, defmodule :erlang, lib/erlang.fz float_to_binary/2) is building on branch fz-sc8.3/erlang-atom-module. Built ahead of fz-sc8.25: the call now resolves through resolve_module_value_call and the ModuleName authority, not callable_name_qualifier, so .25 no longer sits on this path.

title: `defmodule :erlang` and :erlang.float_to_binary/2
